patterns.note: Sections alternate between a deep teal background and a light grey/white background to visually segment content and create a clear reading flow.

A consistent deep teal serves as the primary brand color for backgrounds and major elements, contrasted with white text and accented by a bright, clear blue for calls to action and interactive elements.

The hero section dynamically transforms on scroll: the initial static dark teal background is replaced by a full-bleed, aerial video of a waste truck, while the main hero text remains fixed and overlaid. Simultaneously, the navigation bar becomes sticky and its background transitions to a semi-transparent light color.
Feature and informational sections frequently utilize a grid layout of cards, each containing an icon, a concise heading, a brief description, and a 'learn more' link.

technique_notes: The hero section implements a video background that is revealed or activated as the user scrolls, creating an immediate and engaging visual experience. The main hero text is positioned to remain legible over the dynamic video content.

The navigation bar employs a sticky behavior, transitioning its background from a solid brand color to a semi-transparent light tone and adjusting text color for optimal contrast as it fixes to the top of the viewport.
Content sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors, providing clear breaks and guiding the user through different thematic areas of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by readable body text and smaller uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall density, with a notably airy hero section and consistent vertical padding between distinct content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic hero section, which transitions from a static, branded background to a full-bleed, aerial video on scroll. This creates an immediate, engaging, and memorable visual introduction that effectively showcases the company's operations while maintaining clear messaging.
